## 👋 Hi there
I'm Dom, a Machine Learning & Rendering Engineer based in Karlsruhe, Germany. I recently completed my M.Sc. in Computer Science at KIT, focusing on real-time computer graphics, GPU programming and machine learning.

🔍 **I'm looking for a full-time role** in rendering, graphics, machine learning or computer vision. Feel free to reach out!

- 🎓 **Master's thesis:** Automatic shader level of detail using tiny neural networks and symbolic regression (code coming soon)
- 🎓 **Bachelor's thesis:** [Real-time neural path guiding](https://github.com/dom-wuest/NeuralPathGuiding) with an online-trained MLP in CUDA
- 🧪 **Research @ KIT:** Contributed to research on LLM-driven rendering optimization ([RenderOpt](https://renderopt.github.io))
- 🛰️ **Fraunhofer IOSB (2021–2026):** Deep learning and computer vision for Structure-from-Motion, deployed in C++ with ONNX Runtime ([iVS3D](https://github.com/iVS3D/iVS3D))
- 🛠️ **Tech:** C++, Python, Vulkan, Slang, GLSL, CUDA, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, Qt
- 📫 **Contact:** [kontakt@dom-wuest.de](mailto:kontakt@dom-wuest.de) · more on my [website](https://dom-wuest.de)
